name: Mert
presentingProblem: I've been having panic attacks at work. I'm terrified of losing control in front of my colleagues. I can't stop worrying about everything.
backstory: Mert is a software project manager at a tech company. He grew up with an anxious mother and an absent father. He's been high-achieving since childhood, often using work as a way to feel in control. He's married with one child. The panic attacks started after a public humiliation in a client meeting 6 months ago. He avoids meetings now when possible.

coreBeliefs: I must stay in control at all times
I am responsible for everything going wrong
intermediateBeliefs: If I'm not prepared for every outcome, something terrible will happen
Other people will judge me if I struggle
My worth depends on my performance
automaticThoughts: What if I have a panic attack in the next meeting?
My heart is racing — something is wrong with me
I need to check this email one more time
values: Being a good father and husband
Being seen as reliable and competent
